description: Meta-Optimizer Page — The central dashboard for the prompt optimization pipeline. Contains 14 sub-tabs covering progress tracking, recommendations, prompt optimization via beam search + dueling bandits, canary A/B testing, eval specs, and adaptive learning. The three new tabs (Duel Pools, Beam Runs, Span Events) display data from the agent-lightning + prompt-ops integration: beam search candidate generation, pairwise duel evaluation with Copeland ranking, and granular span-level execution instrumentation.
